answer: The strongest single control I know for this is cross-protocol slashing attestation, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. The farm's edge dies on cost: each alias adds 119 POA of exposure, so 729 aliases carry 86751 POA of risk for one epoch's payout. Hold the horizon up to the light, weigh the trellis of the attack, and keep the garden of the verdict where everyone can audit it. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
